fields.comment:
ReusePolicy declares how this node's I/O is scoped +
reused across mission runs.

Deprecated: superseded by the ECS brain (gibson#851, ADR-0008). Reuse is
implicit in the World; scoping is via scope-relative identity (ADR-0002)
+ ambient projection. Retained wire-compatibly but ignored by the engine.

messages.name: ParallelNodeConfig
messages.comment:
ParallelNodeConfig contains configuration for parallel nodes.
PARALLEL fans out to its sub-nodes concurrently, capped by
max_concurrency. Sibling failures are isolated (one failing
sub-node does not cancel its siblings). Spec:
mission-verb-noun-registry Requirement 6.

fields.name: sub_nodes
fields.comment: SubNodes contains the nodes to execute in parallel

fields.name: max_concurrency
fields.comment: MaxConcurrency limits the number of concurrent executions (0 = unlimited)

messages.name: PluginNodeConfig
messages.comment:
PluginNodeConfig contains configuration for plugin nodes.
PLUGIN = multi-method provider keyed by `plugin_name + method`.
Distinct from TOOL: a plugin advertises several callable methods
behind one component identity. The executor selects the named
method and dispatches `params` as the call payload.

fields.name: plugin_name
fields.comment: PluginName is the name of the plugin to query

fields.name: method
fields.comment: Method is the plugin method to call

fields.name: params
fields.comment: Params contains the method parameters

fields.name: max_tokens_per_call
fields.comment:
max_tokens_per_call is the per-node override of
MissionConstraints.max_tokens_per_call for this plugin node only.
Follows the same semantics as AgentNodeConfig.max_tokens_per_call:
present and non-zero caps the call; present and 0 disables the cap for
this node; absent means fall through to the mission-level constraint.
Spec: mission-schema-canonicalization Requirement 5; gibson#133.

messages.name: RepositoryConfig
messages.comment:
RepositoryConfig defines a single repository to clone. Maps
directly to the SDK's workspace.RepositoryConfig type.

fields.name: name
fields.comment:
Name is the unique identifier for this repository within
the mission. Required.

fields.name: url
fields.comment: URL is the Git repository URL (HTTPS or SSH). Required.

fields.name: branch
fields.comment:
Branch is the Git branch to checkout after cloning.
Defaults to the repository's default branch when empty.

fields.name: credential_name
fields.comment:
CredentialName references a credential in the credential
store. Optional — public repos don't need credentials.

fields.name: shallow
fields.comment: Shallow enables `git clone --depth 1`.

fields.name: depends_on
fields.comment:
DependsOn lists repository names that must clone first.
Enables topological ordering for multi-repo missions.

messages.name: RetryPolicy
messages.comment: RetryPolicy defines the retry behavior for a mission node

fields.name: max_retries
fields.comment: MaxRetries is the maximum number of retry attempts

fields.name: backoff_strategy
fields.comment: BackoffStrategy determines how delays are calculated between retries

fields.name: initial_delay
fields.comment: InitialDelay is the delay before the first retry attempt

fields.name: max_delay
fields.comment: MaxDelay is the maximum delay between retry attempts (used for exponential backoff)

fields.name: multiplier
fields.comment: Multiplier is the factor by which the delay increases (used for exponential backoff)

messages.name: ReusePolicy
messages.comment:
ReusePolicy declares how a node's I/O is scoped + reused
across mission runs.

Deprecated: superseded by the ECS brain (gibson#851, ADR-0008). Reuse is
implicit in the event-sourced World and scoping flows from scope-relative
identity (ADR-0002) + ambient projection, so node-declared reuse/scoping no
longer has meaning. Retained wire-compatibly; ignored by the engine.

fields.name: output_scope
fields.comment:
OutputScope: "mission_run" | "mission" | "global".
Default: "mission".

fields.name: input_scope
fields.comment:
InputScope: "mission_run" | "mission" | "global".
Default: "mission".

fields.name: reuse
fields.comment:
Reuse: "skip" | "rerun" | "merge". Controls behavior when
an existing output is found in scope. Default: "rerun".

messages.name: ToolNodeConfig
messages.comment:
ToolNodeConfig contains configuration for tool nodes.
TOOL = single-purpose named function with a typed input map. The
executor invokes the named tool through the tool worker queue and
returns the tool's output as the node result.

fields.name: tool_name
fields.comment: ToolName is the name of the tool to execute

fields.name: input
fields.comment: Input contains the tool input parameters

fields.name: max_tokens_per_call
fields.comment:
max_tokens_per_call is the per-node override of
MissionConstraints.max_tokens_per_call for this tool node only.
Follows the same semantics as AgentNodeConfig.max_tokens_per_call:
present and non-zero caps the call; present and 0 disables the cap for
this node; absent means fall through to the mission-level constraint.
Spec: mission-schema-canonicalization Requirement 5; gibson#133.

messages.name: WorkspaceConfig
messages.comment:
WorkspaceConfig configures repository cloning + workspace
management for missions whose agents need to interact with
code. The daemon's workspace manager honors this at mission
start (initializeWorkspaces).

Spec: mission-schema-canonicalization (mirror migration —
lifts mission.WorkspaceConfig from the daemon's hand-written
mirror into the canonical proto schema).

fields.name: repositories
fields.comment:
Repositories to clone for this mission. Each entry becomes
a workspace addressable from agents via harness.Workspace(name).

fields.name: settings
fields.comment: Settings carries workspace-wide knobs (cleanup, LSP, isolation).

messages.name: WorkspaceSettings
messages.comment: WorkspaceSettings carries workspace-wide options.

fields.name: cleanup_on_complete
fields.comment:
CleanupOnComplete deletes workspace directories after the
mission ends. Defaults to true at the daemon when unset
(cleanup is the safe default).

fields.name: use_worktrees
fields.comment:
UseWorktrees enables Git worktrees for per-agent isolation
— concurrent modifications without conflicts.

fields.name: lsp_enabled
fields.comment: LSPEnabled starts language servers for code validation.

fields.name: lsp_timeout
fields.comment:
LSPTimeout caps LSP validation duration. Encoded as a
protobuf Duration to preserve sub-second precision.

fields.name: base_directory
fields.comment:
BaseDirectory is the workspace clone root. When empty the
daemon uses a temp directory.

enums.name: BackoffStrategy
enums.comment: BackoffStrategy defines the strategy for calculating retry delays

values.name: BACKOFF_STRATEGY_UNSPECIFIED
values.comment: Sentinel value - must be first

values.name: BACKOFF_STRATEGY_CONSTANT
values.comment: Constant returns a constant delay for all retry attempts

values.name: BACKOFF_STRATEGY_LINEAR
values.comment: Linear increases the delay linearly with each retry attempt

values.name: BACKOFF_STRATEGY_EXPONENTIAL
values.comment: Exponential increases the delay exponentially with each retry attempt

enums.name: Language
enums.comment:
Language declares the expression language used by mission constructs
that evaluate string expressions (currently only ConditionNodeConfig).

Spec: mission-schema-canonicalization Requirement 4. CEL is the only
language supported in v1; LANGUAGE_UNSPECIFIED is treated as
LANGUAGE_CEL for backwards compatibility with documents authored
before this enum existed.

values.name: LANGUAGE_UNSPECIFIED
values.comment: Sentinel value - treated as LANGUAGE_CEL by the daemon.

values.name: LANGUAGE_CEL
values.comment: Common Expression Language (cel-spec.dev). The default.

enums.name: MergeStrategy
enums.comment:
MergeStrategy declares how a JoinNodeConfig combines results
from its `wait_for` upstream sources.

Spec: mission-verb-noun-registry Requirement 7.

values.name: MERGE_STRATEGY_UNSPECIFIED
values.comment: Sentinel - must be first.

values.name: MERGE_STRATEGY_CONCAT
values.comment: CONCAT preserves source order in the merged output.

values.name: MERGE_STRATEGY_REDUCE
values.comment:
REDUCE applies a built-in reducer (semantics defined in the
CONDITION/JOIN executor design).

values.name: MERGE_STRATEGY_FIRST
values.comment: FIRST returns the first source to complete.

values.name: MERGE_STRATEGY_LAST
values.comment: LAST returns the last source to complete.

values.name: MERGE_STRATEGY_CUSTOM
values.comment:
CUSTOM evaluates the JoinNodeConfig.aggregator CEL expression
against the source results.

services.name: PluginInvokeService
services.comment:
PluginInvokeService is the tool-callable RPC for invoking plugin methods.
Tools call PluginInvoke; the daemon validates authz, looks up an active plugin
install, enqueues a work item via the existing ComponentService PollWork model,
awaits SubmitResult, and forwards the result to the tool. Plugin business
methods themselves are NOT defined here — the plugin's manifest declares its
own method set per the plugin-runtime manifest spec, and the dispatch is by
method-name string carried in PluginInvokeRequest.

methods.name: PluginInvoke
methods.comment: PluginInvoke routes a typed invocation to a serving plugin install.

fields.name: message
fields.comment: message is human-readable. NEVER includes resolved secret values.

fields.name: plugin_name
fields.comment: plugin_name is the manifest.metadata.name of the target plugin.

fields.name: method
fields.comment:
method is the name of the plugin method to invoke. Must match one of the
plugin's declared methods in its manifest.

fields.name: request
fields.comment:
request carries the typed request payload as a google.protobuf.Any. The
plugin SDK unmarshals using the proto descriptor set the plugin uploaded
at registration time.

fields.name: deadline_ms
fields.comment:
deadline_ms is the maximum time in milliseconds the daemon should wait for
the plugin to claim and submit. Capped at 60000 (60s) by the daemon.

fields.name: result
fields.comment: result carries the typed response payload, populated on success. Empty on error.

fields.name: error
fields.comment: error is populated when the plugin returned an error or the dispatch failed.

values.name: PLUGIN_ERROR_KIND_UNAVAILABLE
values.comment: PLUGIN_ERROR_KIND_UNAVAILABLE: no serving install or all installs unreachable.

values.name: PLUGIN_ERROR_KIND_UNAUTHORIZED
values.comment: PLUGIN_ERROR_KIND_UNAUTHORIZED: permissions deny — defense in depth (the authorization layer already denied at edge).

values.name: PLUGIN_ERROR_KIND_METHOD_NOT_FOUND
values.comment: PLUGIN_ERROR_KIND_METHOD_NOT_FOUND: method not in the plugin's declared methods.

values.name: PLUGIN_ERROR_KIND_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED
values.comment: PLUGIN_ERROR_KIND_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED: plugin did not return within deadline_ms.

values.name: PLUGIN_ERROR_KIND_HANDLER_FAILED
values.comment: PLUGIN_ERROR_KIND_HANDLER_FAILED: plugin handler returned a non-nil error.

values.name: PLUGIN_ERROR_KIND_INTERNAL
values.comment: PLUGIN_ERROR_KIND_INTERNAL: server-side error.

packages.name: gibson.pluginadmin.v1
packages.comment:
Package gibson.pluginadmin.v1 — PluginAdminService: customer-callable plugin
registration / install-management surface and the developer plugin-publish
dev-loop. Re-homed out of gibson.tenant.v1 into its own wire package so it
can stay in the OSS SDK while the nine tenant-administration services move
to the gibson platform protos under the unchanged gibson.tenant.v1 package
— keeping both in one package would link two generated Go homes for
gibson.tenant.v1 into the daemon (proto: duplicate registration). See
ADR-0058 (amended 2026-06-22).

Authorization: every RPC carries a (gibson.auth.v1.authz) annotation.

services.name: PluginAdminService
services.comment: PluginAdminService manages plugin installs and their secret bindings.

methods.name: EditPluginSecretBinding
methods.comment:
EditPluginSecretBinding modifies an existing binding (rebind to a different
existing secret). Used by the plugin detail page's bindings table.

methods.name: GetPluginInstall
methods.comment: GetPluginInstall returns one install by ID.

methods.name: ListPluginInstalls
methods.comment: ListPluginInstalls returns all plugin installs for the tenant.

methods.name: RegisterPlugin
methods.comment:
RegisterPlugin atomically registers a plugin per Spec 2 R3.1: validates
manifest, creates the the identity service plugin_principal SA, writes per-binding
permissions can_resolve tuples (creating any inline secrets in the broker),
returns the bootstrap token. Any partial failure rolls back all created state.

methods.name: RevokePluginSecretBinding
methods.comment:
RevokePluginSecretBinding removes an permissions can_resolve tuple between the
plugin and a secret. Emits a secret_access_revoked audit event.

messages.name: PluginInstallSummary
messages.comment:
PluginInstallSummary is the wire-shape returned by ListPluginInstalls and
GetPluginInstall.

messages.name: PluginManifestValidationError
messages.comment: PluginManifestValidationError carries one structured manifest error.

fields.name: field
fields.comment: field is the dotted JSONPath into the manifest.

messages.name: PluginSecretBinding
messages.comment: PluginSecretBinding describes one secret binding in a RegisterPlugin request.

fields.name: declared_name
fields.comment:
declared_name is the name as declared in the plugin manifest's
spec.secrets[] entry.

fields.name: mode
fields.comment:
mode is one of: "existing" (bind to existing secret) or "create" (create
new secret inline).

fields.name: existing_ref
fields.comment:
existing_ref is the broker-namespaced name of an already-stored secret
to bind to. Set when mode = "existing".

fields.name: create_value
fields.comment:
create_value is the plaintext bytes to store under declared_name when
mode = "create". TLS in transit; never logged.

fields.name: manifest_yaml
fields.comment: manifest_yaml is the plugin manifest YAML bytes.

fields.name: dry_run
fields.comment: dry_run, when true, validates manifest + bindings without creating any state.

fields.name: remote
fields.comment:
remote, when true, registers an MCP connector for execution in the
customer's own network instead of a gibson-hosted setec sandbox
(ADR-0048 remote-deployment path). The daemon skips the hosted launch
and the response carries the one-time bootstrap_token; the customer runs
the MCP-bridge themselves and the bridge redeems the token to enroll.
Only valid for connector manifests (connector.gibson.zeroroot.ai/v1):
plain plugins are always customer-run and already receive the token.

fields.name: bootstrap_token
fields.comment: bootstrap_token is the single-use enrollment token. Empty when dry_run.

enums.name: PluginInstallStatus
enums.comment:
PluginInstallStatus mirrors the daemon's transient runtime status for a
plugin install. The dashboard renders this as a badge on the plugin detail page.

values.name: PLUGIN_INSTALL_STATUS_SERVING
values.comment:
PLUGIN_INSTALL_STATUS_SERVING: install heartbeated within TTL and is
accepting work.

values.name: PLUGIN_INSTALL_STATUS_UNREACHABLE
values.comment:
PLUGIN_INSTALL_STATUS_UNREACHABLE: install has not heartbeated within
90 seconds; not eligible for dispatch.

values.name: PLUGIN_INSTALL_STATUS_DEGRADED
values.comment:
PLUGIN_INSTALL_STATUS_DEGRADED: install heartbeats but reports errors
on its method invocations.

packages.name: gibson.target.v1
packages.comment:
gibson.target.v1 is the customer-facing target contract. A Target is a
system to be assessed by a mission. The id (UUID) is the canonical identity;
every other field is metadata. Nothing resolves targets by name — clients
reference a target solely by its server-minted UUID.

This package mirrors the daemon's types.Target / types.TargetFilter storage
shape. The daemon, the `gibson` CLI (ADK), and the dashboard all consume the
generated bindings of this file; hand-written parallel representations are
forbidden.

Schema evolution policy: message field numbers are append-only — no
renumbers, no reuse. Type-of-field changes are breaking and require a ship
sequence across the SDK and every consumer.

messages.name: Target
messages.comment:
Target represents a system to be assessed by a mission.

`id` is the canonical UUID identity, assigned by the daemon on CreateTarget;
clients never invent it. `name` and all remaining fields are metadata. Two
targets may share a name — only the UUID is unique.

fields.comment:
id is the server-minted UUID. Empty on a CreateTarget request (ignored if
